Practicals use explicit assumptions, small hypothetical datasets and reproducible R examples. The two pathways reuse common practicals rather than copying them. All code examples run without biological downloads.

## Available practicals

- [Biological databases and sequence retrieval](tutorials/p01_databases.qmd)
- [Basic sequence analysis and manipulation](tutorials/p02_sequences.qmd)
- [Command-line bioinformatics and reproducible execution](tutorials/p03_command_line.qmd)
- [Sequence similarity and evidence for homology](tutorials/p04_similarity.qmd)
- [Alignment and conserved-region analysis](tutorials/p05_alignment.qmd)
- [Distances, clustering and phylogenetic interpretation](tutorials/p06_phylogeny.qmd)
- [Protein structure and structural bioinformatics](tutorials/p07_structure.qmd)
- [Sequencing data quality assessment](tutorials/p08_sequence_qc.qmd)
- [RNA-seq counts, contrasts and uncertainty](tutorials/p09_rnaseq.qmd)
- [Functional annotation and pathway enrichment](tutorials/p10_pathways.qmd)
- [Biological network construction and interpretation](tutorials/p11_networks.qmd)
- [Biological data visualization with explicit units](tutorials/p12_visualization.qmd)
- [Scientific reporting and reproducible analysis records](tutorials/p13_reporting.qmd)
- [Sample identity, table joins and missing assays](tutorials/p14_data_handling.qmd)
- [Multi-omics experimental design in animal production](tutorials/p15_experimental_design.qmd)
- [Quality assessment and preprocessing across omics layers](tutorials/p16_multiomics_qc.qmd)
- [Metabolomics processing, standards and feature interpretation](tutorials/p17_metabolomics.qmd)
- [Proteomics analysis and missing-value sensitivity](tutorials/p18_proteomics.qmd)
- [Exploratory multi-omics analysis and principal components](tutorials/p19_exploration.qmd)
- [Regularized regression and held-out prediction](tutorials/p20_prediction.qmd)

Use the [curriculum crosswalk](course_map.qmd#practical-session-coverage) to locate each session in the two original outlines. Shared practicals can have different pathway extensions.
